name: 高中词书
description: 高考核心词汇，覆盖阅读与写作高频词

example.en: The plan was abandoned.
Plants absorb water through their roots.
example.cn: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

example.en: Her academic performance improved greatly.
example.cn: 她的学业成绩进步很大。

example.en: He accompanied his grandmother to the hospital.
She accomplished the task ahead of time.
He gave a brief account of the accident.
example.cn: 他对事故做了简要描述。

example.en: The weather report is usually accurate.
example.cn: 天气预报通常是准确的。

example.en: They accused him of lying.
She acknowledged her own mistake.
Children acquire language very quickly.
He quickly adapted to the new school.
Make sure you get adequate sleep.
You can adjust the height of the chair.
example.cn: 你可以调整椅子的高度。

example.en: I admire her courage.
The school adopted a new teaching method.
example.cn: 学校采用了一种新的教学方法。

example.en: Speaking two languages is a big advantage.
example.cn: 会说两种语言是一大优势。

example.en: Doctors advocate a balanced diet.
Smoking affects your health badly.
Her ambition is to become a scientist.
example.cn: 她的抱负是成为一名科学家。

example.en: Scientists analyzed the water samples.
Our ancestors created brilliant cultures.
example.cn: 我们的祖先创造了灿烂的文化。

example.en: The school announced the exam results.
The annual sports meeting is in October.
example.cn: 年度运动会在十月举行。

example.en: Deep breathing can reduce anxiety.
He apologized for being late.
The idea appeals to young people.
example.cn: 这个想法对年轻人有吸引力。

example.en: Exercise gives you a good appetite.
I appreciate your timely help.
We need a new approach to the problem.
example.cn: 我们需要解决问题的新方法。

example.en: Her parents approved of the plan.
example.cn: 她的父母赞成这个计划。

example.en: They argued about where to go.
Problems may arise at any time.
She arranged the flowers in a vase.
The lake is artificial but beautiful.
example.cn: 这个湖是人造的，但很美。

example.en: The students assembled on the playground.
Teachers assess students' progress each term.
example.cn: 老师每学期评估学生的进步。

example.en: The teacher assigned us some homework.
example.cn: 老师给我们布置了作业。

example.en: Two nurses assisted the doctor.
I assumed he had gone home.
example.cn: 我本以为他已经回家了。

example.en: Please attach a photo to the form.
example.cn: 请在表格上附一张照片。

example.en: He attempted to break the record.
A positive attitude leads to success.
The exhibition attracted many visitors.
example.cn: 展览吸引了众多参观者。

example.en: He is an authority on ancient history.
example.cn: 他是古代史方面的权威。

example.en: The door has an automatic lock.
The library is available to all students.
example.cn: 图书馆对所有学生开放。

example.en: The average temperature rose by two degrees.
She won the first prize award.
There was an awkward silence.
example.cn: 出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。

example.en: Language is no longer a barrier.
Exercise benefits both body and mind.
The medicine tastes bitter.
Don't blame others for your mistakes.
example.cn: 别把自己的错误归咎于别人。

example.en: Too much homework is a heavy burden.
example.cn: 过多的作业是沉重的负担。

example.en: He calculated the cost carefully.
The city started a recycling campaign.
example.cn: 该市发起了一场回收利用活动。

example.en: The hall has a seating capacity of 500.
Be cautious when sharing personal information.
example.cn: 分享个人信息时要谨慎。

example.en: The opening ceremony was impressive.
Learning to cook was a fun challenge.
example.cn: 学做饭是个有趣的挑战。

example.en: Kindness is her main characteristic.
We should stay calm under any circumstance.
example.cn: 任何情况下我们都应保持冷静。

example.en: My colleagues helped me a lot.
The teacher wrote a comment on my essay.
example.cn: 老师在我的文章上写了评语。

example.en: We communicate mainly by email.
example.cn: 我们主要通过电子邮件交流。

example.en: A dog can be a loyal companion.
example.cn: 狗可以成为忠实的伙伴。

example.en: He entered an English competition.
example.cn: 他参加了一场英语比赛。

example.en: The manager dealt with the complaint politely.
example.cn: 经理礼貌地处理了这起投诉。

example.en: I can't concentrate with all this noise.
example.cn: 这么吵我无法集中注意力。

example.en: Gravity is a basic concept in physics.
example.cn: 重力是物理学中的基本概念。

example.en: Air pollution is a public concern.
example.cn: 空气污染是公众关注的问题。

example.en: They settled the conflict peacefully.
Don't confuse "affect" with "effect".
example.cn: 不要混淆 affect 和 effect。

example.en: I congratulated her on her success.
example.cn: 我为她的成功向她表示祝贺。

example.en: Every choice has its consequences.
Everyone can contribute to the project.
example.cn: 每个人都能为这个项目做出贡献。

example.en: Her words convinced me at last.
The two teams cooperated very well.
He was criticized for carelessness.
We had a heated debate in class.
example.cn: 我们在课堂上进行了激烈的辩论。

example.en: The country declared independence in 1960.
He declined the invitation politely.
She dedicated her life to teaching.
They defeated the champions 3-1.
example.cn: 他们以3比1击败了冠军队。

example.en: Soldiers defend our country.
The flight was delayed by fog.
Handle the delicate glass carefully.
example.cn: 小心拿放这只易碎的玻璃杯。

example.en: The postman delivers letters every morning.
example.cn: 邮递员每天早上投递信件。

example.en: The job demands great patience.
example.cn: 这份工作需要极大的耐心。

example.en: The teacher demonstrated the experiment.
He denied breaking the window.
You deserve a good rest.
She has a strong desire to travel.
Never give in to despair.
He determined to give up smoking.
He devotes his spare time to reading.
example.cn: 他把业余时间都用在读书上。

example.en: She faced the dilemma of work or family.
example.cn: 她面临工作与家庭的两难选择。

example.en: Self-discipline is the key to progress.
Most people here make a living from agriculture.
example.cn: 这里大多数人以农业为生。

example.en: Loud noises annoy the neighbors.
example.cn: 巨大的噪音让邻居们很恼火。
